status: Normative component ABI. Qualification and migration claims are recorded separately.

original_owner.scope: Complete original bytes before reversible routing additions.

composition.owner: Native LF split, native chunk/resume state machine, native stable permutation, native reverse overlapping line edits and LF rendering.
composition.search: HIA emits each search request. Rust calls the existing real HIA seek_sequence on unchanged original lines and the native-selected context/pattern slice, then returns its Option index. No duplicated matcher, Rust matching fallback or cross-archive HIA call.
composition.preserve: Existing real HIA SourceFile parses/projects original logical lines and applies/renders the native-sorted replacement plan.
composition.rust: Allocation, metadata encoding, owned String/Vec storage, checked native indices/spans, synchronous callback transport and exact error formatting. Static enum dispatch selects native components. Original filesystem, PathUri, symlink/sandbox policy and similar TextDiff remain host boundaries.
composition.continuation: Explicit caller-owned continuation, not a cryptographic token. Native admission checks structural state and callback ranges. Production binds lengths and callback truth to actual Strings/native results; raw metadata alone cannot authenticate text equality.
composition.evidence: Whole public oracle parity does not imply observation of every original private search/replacement trace. Raw continuation tests are a separate contract gate.

abi.c: uint64_t f0(const uint8_t *source,uint64_t source_len,uint8_t *output,uint64_t output_capacity,uint8_t *workspace,uint64_t workspace_len)
abi.encoding: All fields are LE u64. Exact descriptor length; unaligned buffers allowed. Caller supplies live disjoint buffers and does not mutate them during the call. No pointers retained.

statuses.4294967294: SHORT fixed workspace/output header or required emit output capacity.
statuses.4294967295: INVALID metadata, reserved field, continuation/callback range, extent or checked capacity/byte bound overflow.

abi.atomicity: All nonzero returns leave output/source/workspace unchanged. Source/workspace are never written. Query writes only its fixed output header. Sort/render use admitted output memory as scratch after validation; successful emit may alter every byte before needed_bytes. Bytes after needed_bytes remain unchanged.
precedence: non-LF source must be empty; exact descriptor tables, flags and state admission else INVALID
LF full UTF8 validation else INVALID_UTF8
abi.scale: No bootstrap 1MiB production cap. All extents use actual buffer lengths; numeric sums use checked bounds before stores.

0/1.name: LF parse query/emit
0/1.semantics: LF byte split only, followed by removal of exactly one trailing empty split item. CR remains text; empty source gives zero lines. Headers identical for query/emit.

2/3.name: Planner step query/emit
admission: mode<=1; phase<=3; booleans<=1; reserved0; index<=chunk_count; cursor<=L; if L=0 then last length0
phase0 requires found=index0; absent callback requires index0
at index==chunk_count require phase0, no answer and empty chunk metadata/flags; return Done
phase1 requires context_present; uses pattern1 and eof=false regardless of chunk EOF flag
phase2/3 require old_count>0; phase3 additionally requires final old length0
Found nonempty pattern must fit L; non-EOF index>=cursor; EOF index=L-P, with cursor constraint retained for Preserve
Empty retry requires Some(cursor); None differs from Some(0)

actions.1: Search current chunk context, phase1, singleton pattern, eof0
actions.2: Search current chunk old_lines[..requested_pattern_count], phase2/3, requested EOF
actions.3: Current chunk complete; replacement records in discovery order, next chunk index+1, native cursor, phase0
actions.4: Semantic error; current chunk index; code1 missing context, code2 missing expected old lines, code3 reached invalid Preserve context ordering

semantics: Original old=[] inserts at L, except Normalize with final empty original row inserts at L-1. This branch does not advance cursor beyond any prior successful context search.
Full old search only retries after None and final old length0. Drop exactly one old empty and, only when empty, exactly one new tail. No second retry.
Normalize ignores context index values and emits one whole replacement.

Preserve checks each pair against effective old/new lengths first. First out-of-range pair means break, including MAX; later pairs are ignored. Only reached in-range decreasing/repeated indices causing subtraction/slice failure produce code3.
Kept context rows remain original text/ending. Normal match advances cursor to matched start+effective old length.
Ignored metadata values remain legal in Normalize, original-old-empty branch, failed lookups and after first out-of-range pair.
Zero-record query may be committed directly; nonzero-record emit repeats the same immutable step and the entire query header.

4/5.name: Stable permutation query/emit
4/5.records: Original discovery indices sorted by (start key, original index). All u64 keys including MAX allowed.
4/5.implementation: Native in-place heap sort; O(R log R), stable tie equivalence without Rust sorting.

6/7.name: Normalize reverse edit/render query/emit
6/7.source: Empty; IDs bound by host to real UTF8 Strings.
6/7.pools: P>=2. Pool0 is LF length1; pool1 is empty length0. Original IDs in [2,P). New first in [2,P], count<=P-first. Strings with embedded LF/CR/NUL retain logical identity.
admission: Exact table lengths and reserved zero.
Nondecreasing starts <= original L, overlap allowed. Delete min(old_length,current_count-start); old_length may be any u64.
Per-occurrence original/new byte sums plus possible final LF count must fit u64 before any store. Repeated IDs/ranges count repeatedly.
Reverse-count simulation includes initial L and every post-insert count in the scratch peak. All count/capacity arithmetic admitted before writes.
6/7.records: Emit prefix contains actual_render_pool_id_count pool IDs; remaining admitted bytes are unspecified scratch.
algorithm: Copy original IDs into native output scratch.
Process stable-sorted replacements in reverse, shift surviving tail once in the correct direction and insert native IDs.
Append pool1 iff result empty or final text nonempty.
Expand backward to text/LF/text/.../text. Host only copies emitted pool IDs; it does not join or split.

errors.old: ApplyPatchError::ComputeReplacements: Failed to find expected lines in {path}:\n{original_old_lines joined by LF}
